import io
import dotenv.parser as P

# 不落盘，仅内存验证候选修复方向：line += string.count("\n")
def advance(self, string):
    self.chars += len(string)
    self.line += string.count("\n")
P.Position.advance = advance

for label, text in [("LF", "X=1\nY=2\nZ=3\n"),
                    ("CRLF", "X=1\r\nY=2\r\nZ=3\r\n"),
                    ("MIXED", "X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n"),
                    ("BLANK", "\n\nX=1\nY=2\n")]:
    rows = list(P.parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(label, "->", [(r.key, r.original.line) for r in rows])
